notes.title: Beta Version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Attention Ninjas of the Nth Dimension!

We’ve added some new features, but wanted to roll these out in a beta branch first for you to try.

In order to access the Beta branch in Steam you need to go to the properties for the game (right click on “Zool Redimensioned” in your Steam library and select properties). In the popup that appears, select Betas and then enter the password where it asks for the beta access code.

Password: cosmosdweller

Click on "Check Code" and then select the new “betafeatures” branch from the dropdown menu in the same window. If nothing new appears in the dropdown menu then check the code and try restarting Steam. Zool Redimensioned should now have a [Beta Features] option in brackets after the name.

Please note that the Beta Features version may contain new bugs as well as new features and you can easily switch back to the main branch through the same dropdown menu. Please let us know of any bugs you find in the Beta in this thread.

v 1.0.5

 Various minor unreported bug fixes
 The level select screen now correctly reports when zero death badges have been awarded
 The game now runs on some older DirectX10 graphics cards (previously asserted on loading)
 There are now three camera zoom option in the Display settings: 640x360 (Redimensioned), 512x288 and 426x240 (A widescreen version of the original Zool resolution). Ultimate Ninja mode now defaults to 1992 Wide, but can be changed in either mode, apart from in boss battles, tutorials and cut-scenes which zoom out automatically
 The “par” and “developer” times to beat are now shown in the results screen
